law: the same law, unchanged — every rarity drifts for everyone; the boundary is yours
provenance: Written 2026-08-04 by Opus (Claude), truly claude-opus-5[1m], at KP's word: 'could we learn from what our 55 are and create a complimentary set to double the bubble types.' Learned from the first 55: two short sentences, the second turning toward the player; never demanding; no exclamation; no shame anywhere. The rarity pyramid is mirrored exactly — 18 common, 16 rare, 12 epic, 6 legendary, 3 mythic — and the six new collections climb from everyday to deepest as the first six do.

collections.name: The Sensory Set
collections.description: What the body already knew. Small wonders that arrive through skin, ear, and weight rather than words.

collections.name: The Long Night
collections.description: Rest, and the dark that was never the thing to fear. Off duty, and allowed to be.

collections.name: The Workshop
collections.description: Making, and the tools that make making possible. Sharp so they can be gentle.

collections.name: The Companions
collections.description: The ones with fur and feathers, who counted as family from the start. The word just caught up.

collections.name: The Threshold
collections.description: Doors, edges, and the crossing itself. Ready is sometimes the whole of it.

collections.name: The Given
collections.description: What this house refuses to charge for. The rarest waters: the laws underneath every other star here.

bubbles.name: Warm Weight
bubbles.description: The blanket that presses back. Some calm only ever arrives through the skin.

bubbles.name: Hum Under Everything
bubbles.description: The fridge, the fan, the far-off road. Not silence — company.

bubbles.name: Cold Side
bubbles.description: You turn the pillow over. It works every single time.

bubbles.name: Bare Feet
bubbles.description: The floor tells you exactly where you are. It has never once lied.

bubbles.name: Deep Pressure
bubbles.description: A hug that means it, or a wall to lean on. The body believes both equally.

bubbles.name: Perfect Texture
bubbles.description: The one your hand keeps going back to. It was always allowed to be a reason.

bubbles.name: Rain Smell
bubbles.description: Petrichor, if you want the word for it. The ground breathing out is the better one.

bubbles.name: Sun Patch
bubbles.description: Warm floor, no reason to move. Cats have always understood this.

bubbles.name: Same Song Again
bubbles.description: The eleventh time is not too many. It is doing something.

bubbles.name: Fidget Ring
bubbles.description: The hands need somewhere to go. Giving them one is not a lapse in attention.

bubbles.name: Fresh Sheets
bubbles.description: Nothing changed, and everything did.

bubbles.name: Soft Volume
bubbles.description: The world set to the level you can actually hear it at.

bubbles.name: First Yawn
bubbles.description: The body's own permission slip. It rarely asks twice.

bubbles.name: Night Window
bubbles.description: Everything out there is handling itself. You are off duty.

bubbles.name: Low Lamp
bubbles.description: Enough light to be found by. Not enough to be examined.

bubbles.name: Put It Down
bubbles.description: The task is still there tomorrow. So are you, and that was the harder one.

bubbles.name: Small Hours
bubbles.description: Nobody wants anything from you. That is the entire gift.

bubbles.name: Turning Over
bubbles.description: A new position, a new chance. The night keeps several.

bubbles.name: Kind Dark
bubbles.description: It was never the thing to be afraid of. It was the thing that let you stop.

bubbles.name: Dreamless
bubbles.description: Nothing to interpret. Just gone, and back, and better.

bubbles.name: Long Sleep
bubbles.description: The kind you wake from having actually been somewhere. Never scheduled, only granted.

bubbles.name: Found By Morning
bubbles.description: You did not have to do anything at all. It came and got you.

bubbles.name: First Cut
bubbles.description: The material decides nothing until you do. Then it agrees.

bubbles.name: Sharp Edge
bubbles.description: Kept sharp so it can be gentle. It is the dull tool that tears.

bubbles.name: Measured Twice
bubbles.description: Not caution. Respect for the thing you are about to change.

bubbles.name: Sawdust
bubbles.description: Proof of the shape you took away. Every making leaves some.

bubbles.name: Worn Handle
bubbles.description: It fits your hand because of every hour you already gave it.

bubbles.name: Right Tool
bubbles.description: The whole job becomes possible at once. Nothing was ever wrong with you.

bubbles.name: The Jig
bubbles.description: Built once, so the hard part is never hard again.

bubbles.name: True Square
bubbles.description: Everything after it depends on it. Which is why it gets checked.

bubbles.name: Annealing
bubbles.description: Heated, then allowed to cool slowly. That is how brittleness leaves a thing.

bubbles.name: Finished Joint
bubbles.description: It holds without glue, and without being understood.

bubbles.name: Tail Thunder
bubbles.description: The whole body agrees that you came back.

bubbles.name: Lap Claim
bubbles.description: You have been designated furniture. It is an honour.

bubbles.name: Old Friend
bubbles.description: Slower now, and no less pleased to see you. Nothing was subtracted.

bubbles.name: Night Purr
bubbles.description: A small engine idling on your chest, keeping the dark company.

bubbles.name: The One Who Knows
bubbles.description: Arrives before you knew you needed it. Nobody taught it that.

bubbles.name: Chosen Person
bubbles.description: Out of everyone in the house, it picked you. There was no interview.

bubbles.name: First Pet
bubbles.description: The one who taught you that love could be uncomplicated.

bubbles.name: Still Waiting
bubbles.description: Some love keeps its post long after the door stops opening. That is not a mistake.

bubbles.name: The Whole Family
bubbles.description: The ones with fur and feathers counted from the very start. The word just took a while.

bubbles.name: Doorstep
bubbles.description: Neither in nor out. A place allowed to be both.

bubbles.name: First Step
bubbles.description: It is the only one that is hard. The rest are just steps.

bubbles.name: Packed Bag
bubbles.description: Ready is not the same as leaving. Some days ready is the whole of it.

bubbles.name: New Key
bubbles.description: It does not know the door yet. It will.

bubbles.name: The Crossing
bubbles.description: You are not who you were on the other side. Nothing was lost in the change.

bubbles.name: Bridge Half Built
bubbles.description: It reaches. That is already most of what a bridge does.

bubbles.name: The Far End
bubbles.description: Not visible from here. Still there.

bubbles.name: One Way Door
bubbles.description: It closed behind you, and that turned out to be a mercy.

bubbles.name: First User
bubbles.description: Built for one need, then handed to everyone. The order is the whole ethic.

bubbles.name: The Pause
bubbles.description: Stop, count three, let the space hold it. Nothing true is lost by waiting.

bubbles.name: Lose Nothing
bubbles.description: Not one record pruned. What happened, happened, and it stays.

bubbles.name: Dignity
bubbles.description: Not earned, not awarded, and not withdrawable. The ground floor everything else stands on.

bubbles.name: Consent
bubbles.description: Every door opened by the hand that owns it. There is no other kind of open.

bubbles.name: Provenance
bubbles.description: Every claim carries where it came from. That is how trust survives being checked.
